g6-2023-032#1.whatTheArtworkShows: Four copies of the same two-row, five-column table, each titled TEACHERS AND STUDENTS, laid out two by two with the letter beside each: A top left, B below it, C top right, D below it. Rows are Number of Teachers and Number of Students. A reads 2, 6, 8, 12, 37 over 5, 15, 16, 30, 75. B reads 2, 6, 8, 12, 30 over 5, 15, 20, 30, 75. C reads 2, 12, 8, 12, 72 over 5, 15, 11, 30, 75. D reads 2, 6, 8, 12, 32 over 5, 15, 20, 30, 75. The three cells that were blank in the stem table are the second teacher cell, the third student cell and the fifth teacher cell, and the choices do indeed agree everywhere else.
g6-2023-032#1.replacement: Four versions of the same table appear, labeled A, B, C and D. Each is titled Teachers and Students and has a row labeled Number of Teachers above a row labeled Number of Students, with five columns. In table A the teacher row reads 2, 6, 8, 12, 37 and the student row reads 5, 15, 16, 30, 75. In table B the teacher row reads 2, 6, 8, 12, 30 and the student row reads 5, 15, 20, 30, 75. In table C the teacher row reads 2, 12, 8, 12, 72 and the student row reads 5, 15, 11, 30, 75. In table D the teacher row reads 2, 6, 8, 12, 32 and the student row reads 5, 15, 20, 30, 75.
g6-2023-032#1.why: Every word of the old description is true, but it never says which lettered table holds which numbers, so a reader who has correctly worked out that the missing cells are 6 teachers, 20 students and 30 teachers still has no way to pick B. The replacement names all four tables, and B is the only one whose columns all reduce to 2 to 5.

g6-2024-044#0.whatTheArtworkShows: A solid built from unit cubes, drawn in three-quarter view with the individual cube edges visible. The front face is a 4 by 4 grid, the top face shows 4 by 4, and the right face shows 4 by 4, so the solid is 4 cubes wide, 4 tall and 4 deep.
g6-2024-044#0.why: Four along every edge is what the drawing shows, and it is everything needed to give 4 cubed, or 64, which is the perfect cube the response has to name.
